Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 161. Category: equipment. Restoratives.

“With Hercule Satan himself as the sponser you know
nothing in this world quenches you like Hetap. This
refressing energy drink is guaranteed to make you feel
ready to fight 2 more tournaments or your money back.
Hetap is not responsible for injury or failed
tournaments in the pursuit of this goal.“
Each time you drink a Hetap™ after the first per long
rest you gain ranks of Exhaustion as listed in the table.
